# Machines that are still decoration

**None.** All 10 machines in this set do what their name says.

This file used to be a list. It existed because eight blocks were shaped like
machines and did nothing, and the point of writing that down was that
"decorative for now" stayed a decision somebody had made rather than something
the set had quietly settled into. Each row was also a class in
`src/main/java/com/elysium/solarpunk/block/pending/`, the sentence that class
returned, and a line on the block item's tooltip — three copies `validate.py`
kept in step so none of them could be updated alone.

The list is empty now, and the machinery that kept it honest is still here:

  * `block/PendingMachine` — the marker interface;
  * `block/pending/PendingMachineBlock` — the shared body of an unfinished one.

Both are kept rather than deleted. A machine added to `MACHINES` in
`tools/gen_solarpunk.py` and regenerated gets its stub, its row here and its
tooltip back with nothing else to do — and deleting hand-written scaffolding
because a list happens to be empty today is the kind of tidying that is only
discovered to be wrong by somebody trying to undo it.

`validate.py` checks the empty case too: no orphan stub may be left in
`block/pending/`, and the "not built yet" tooltip string must not ship when
nothing would ever show it.

## What the machines do

| Block | Name | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `solar_condenser` | Solar Condenser | Gathers power from direct skylight, and less of it under cover. |
| `algae_bioreactor` | Algae Bioreactor | Grows biomass fuel from water and skylight. Needs power, and water touching it. |
| `wind_capstan` | Wind Capstan | Gathers power from open sky, and more of it with height. Wants open sides, not a clear roof. |
| `water_reclaimer` | Water Reclaimer | Condenses clean water out of air and rain, and stores it. Needs power. Counts as a bioreactor's water. |
| `ceramic_kiln` | Ceramic Kiln | Fires clay and glass on less fuel than a furnace needs. Burns fuel or runs on power. |
| `mycelium_press` | Mycelium Press | Presses plant matter and mycelium into panels and fibre. Needs power. |
| `fibre_loom` | Fibre Loom | Weaves cane and fibre into cloth, cord and panels. Needs power. |
| `aquaponics_tank` | Aquaponics Tank | Grows crops and fish together off one supply of water. Needs power, water touching it, and light. |
| `harvester` | Harvester | Cuts and replants the field around it, and posts the crop into whatever is underneath. Needs power. |
| `tree_harvester` | Tree Harvester | Fells grown trees around it, replants a sapling, and posts the timber into whatever is underneath. Needs power. |
